_comment: System hazards (common/src/ships/hazards.ts). Each system rates its hazards 0-5 (systems.json hazardRatings); places within a system can add to them (nearStar, nearBlackHole: within `radii` × the central body's radius, a rating is at least this). A ship's tolerance comes from what it's built of: its materials' hazard ratings by share of its cells (materials.json hazards), plus the bulk rules below. Rating minus tolerance (floored at 0) is the deficit; effects are per point of deficit (hazard effects come later: see the plan).

gravitational._comment: a point per massPerPoint of mass over massFloor; mass in mass-anchor material counts double

thermal._comment: bulk soaks heat: a point for mass over massOver

cryo._comment: a conduit spine keeps power warm: a point for more than conduitsOver conduits

electromagnetic._comment: grounded: the share of conduits in a conductive material × this

radiation.summary: Hull cells lose 0.4% HP a minute and battery capacity drops 8%, per point

thermal.summary: Beam heat builds 20% faster and shield regen drops 15%, per point

corrosive.summary: Armour cells lose 0.3% HP a minute and station repairs cost 25% more, per point

gravitational.summary: Light ships are pulled towards the well and lose 10% of their steering and thrust per point; jump range −15% a point

electromagnetic.summary: A 2-second EMP every 40 s while short
